experiment_plan.objective: Two-sample t test of bmi by smoker status.
experiment_plan.steps:
1. load the data
2. run the test
3. report
experiment_plan.deliverables: the statistic, the p value and n

code:
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

df = pd.read_csv("survey.csv")
t = stats.ttest_ind(df[df.smoker == "yes"]["bmi"], df[df.smoker == "no"]["bmi"])
print(f"n = {len(df)}")
print(f"t = {t.statistic:.1f}, p = {t.pvalue:.3f}")
analysis: Smokers have a significantly higher bmi (t = 3.2, p = 0.001).
